result.description: A fictional desktop accessory hub designed for studio benches and lab workstations, the Orion Dock combines a low-noise cooling fan, integrated USB power distribution, and a detachable cable tray for tidy cable routing. It is intended for mixed peripheral charging and airflow management rather than data storage, graphics, or gaming use. The unit includes a status LED strip, six protected USB-A ports, and an external 12V/5A power input.
result.title: Aster Loop Orion Dock 12V/5A Silent Fan Hub
result.title_description: Silent fan hub and powered USB accessory dock for workspace organization
